solution_selection_rule: Within the fixed iteration-display case and seeds 1--10, select the sealed MV-HGS-SP row with minimum returned cost; break an exact tie by smaller seed.
whole_solution_checks: saved witness hash matches its sealed task row
task and S3 artifact manifests verify
direct evaluate and exact score equal the sealed S3 cost within absolute tolerance 1e-9
every customer appears exactly once in the complete solution
charging remains on the registered date and before route departure
route_detail_rule: Each route is recomputed with the same evaluator for distance, cost, time, fuel, electricity, emissions, on-time customers and load rate. Additive route columns must close to the complete-solution totals within relative and absolute tolerance 1e-6. A route fragment is never passed to the global coverage checker.
failure_rule: Any upstream, hash, feasibility, coverage, date, charging-order, cost, settlement-key or arithmetic mismatch yields HALT. Do not rerun search, change the selected seed, repair the witness, hand-fill a route value or relax a tolerance.
